Name: Click To Move
Author: iqcp1
Description:
[b]Click To Move[/b]
[i]Walk with your mouse — click to go, hold to steer.[/i]
Click anywhere and your farmer walks there, routing around trees, fences and buildings. Hold the button instead and you steer directly. The keyboard still works — any movement key instantly takes back control.
Clicks on things within reach still talk, open, harvest and place as normal. The mod only takes the click when you're pointing at open ground.
[b]Also included:[/b] Ctrl+scroll to zoom, and Alt+Enter for borderless fullscreen at your monitor's native resolution.
[b]Requires:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+. Safe in multiplayer, never touches your saves.
[b]Known issue:[/b] click-to-walk has a faint stutter — the game's own auto-walk drops one frame of movement at each tile boundary. Hold-to-steer is unaffected.
